text: A pharmacy (Apotheke) is marked by a red letter A or a green cross. Pharmacists advise on small problems, and some medicines are only sold with a prescription. Pharmacies take turns to stay open at night and on Sundays, and a sign in the window lists the nearest one (Notdienst).
A weekly market (Wochenmarkt) sells fresh and often regional food. Bring your own bag, and say how much you want: in kilos or grams, or by the piece. Organic food is labelled Bio.
